seo.heading: Count Rummikub Points with AI
seo.text: Take a photo of your Rummikub tiles and instantly get the total score – automatically calculated by artificial intelligence. Our app reliably recognizes all game tiles (1–13 and Joker) using image recognition and saves you the tedious task of adding up points at the game table. Simply upload a photo and you're done.
seo.step1: 📷 Take a photo – lay the tiles flat on the table and photograph from above
seo.step2: ⬆️ Upload image – via drag & drop or click
seo.step3: 🧠 AI recognition – YOLOv8 detects and classifies each tile in a fraction of a second
seo.step4: ✅ Result – total score and recognized tiles at a glance
